# ☁️ SkyNet v0.1 — Initial Beta Release
**Check out the README for the guide on using this mod**
> [!WARNING]
> **⚠️ MANUAL INSTALLATION ONLY — NOT ON MODRINTH OR OTHER MOD DISTRIBUTION PLATFORMS**
>
> SkyNet v0.1 is currently distributed exclusively through this GitHub release. It is **not yet available on Modrinth or other mod-hosting platforms**.
>
> To install it, download the `.jar` file from the **Assets** section below and

The first public beta of **SkyNet**, an AI-powered chatbot built directly into the Minecraft client for Hypixel SkyBlock players.

SkyBlock throws an enormous amount of content at players, from complicated mechanics to unfamiliar items and progression systems. SkyNet aims to reduce the friction by letting players ask questions in-game instead of constantly alt-tabbing to search for answers.

## ✨ What's included

- 💬 In-game AI chat interface
- ☁️ Hypixel SkyBlock-focused assistant
- 🔑 Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) using your own Gemini API key
- ⚡ Quick access through `/skn`
- 🛠️ API key setup through `/setapikey`

## 📦 Installation

1. Install a compatible Minecraft version (26.1.2 for this release!) and Fabric Loader (0.19.5).
2. Install the required Fabric API dependency (0.155.3+26.1.2).
3. Download `skynet-1.0.0.jar` from the Assets section below.
4. Place the JAR in your Minecraft `mods` folder (or whichever launcher you use)
5. Launch Minecraft.
6. Run `/setapikey` and configure your own Gemini API key.
7. Run `/skn` to open SkyNet.

## ⚠️ Beta Notice

This is an early beta release. Bugs, unexpected behavior, and incomplete functionality are possible. Feedback and testing are welcome.

**Requirements:** Minecraft 26.1.2, compatible Fabric Loader and Fabric API, and your own Gemini API key.

**Note:** This release provides an in-game assistant. It does not guarantee that every answer is accurate or up to date.
